Getting Started

Your first few steps in SPIKE.

1

Create your account

Choose the sign-up option on the welcome screen and follow the prompts. If you already have an account, simply sign in.

2

Set up your profile

Choose a username and add a profile picture and information you want people to see.

3

Find people

Explore profiles, suggestions and the Friends area to discover people you know or want to connect with.

4

Start exploring

Browse your Feed, post an update, follow people, send a friend request, start a conversation or explore Rooms.

Tip: Use the main navigation to move between the areas you use most. If you get stuck, check the FAQ below.

Your Account & Profile

Make your SPIKE identity your own.

Edit your profile

Update your username, profile picture, cover image and profile information from your profile.

Share with your SPIKE QR

Open your profile QR option to display a code that another person can scan to quickly find and connect with you.

Share your profile

Use the profile sharing option to copy or share your profile with someone else.

Password recovery

If you forget your password, use the recovery option on the sign-in screen and follow the instructions.

Account, Sessions & Loading

What to do when SPIKE is slow, signed out, or waiting for data.

Profile keeps loading

Wait briefly, then retry. If it still times out, check your connection and sign in again. A profile-loading problem should not prevent the rest of the app from being usable.

Notifications do not load

Refresh the Notifications page. If SPIKE asks you to sign in again, your saved session may no longer be valid.

Live data looks stale

Check your connection, refresh the current page, and reopen the conversation or Room. Live presence can change as people connect or disconnect.

Sign in again

If a page reports an expired or invalid session, return to the sign-in screen and authenticate again before retrying the action.

Feed & Stories

See what's happening and share your own updates.

Browse the Feed

Explore personalized, discovery and trending content. Available feed views and sorting options help you find the posts you care about.

Create a post

Create an update and, where supported, add photos, videos, audio or links. Use the audience options shown before sharing.

Interact with posts

Like or react, comment, reply, repost, save and share content using the actions shown on each post.

Use Stories

Open the Stories row to view updates. Move through stories, interact and reply when those options are available.

Save things for later

Use Save when you want to keep a post or supported content handy for later.

Report content

If something violates community expectations, use the available report option instead of engaging with it.

Friends & Profiles

Build your connections and discover people.

Send a friend request

Open someone's profile and use the available connection option. Pending requests can be managed from Friends.

Manage requests

Review incoming requests and accept or decline them. You can also manage requests you have sent.

Discover people

Use suggestions and the people area to discover new connections. Activity indicators may vary.

Control interactions

Use profile safety controls when you need to limit or stop interactions with another account.

Private Messages

Keep conversations simple, organized and personal.

Start chatting

  1. Open Messages.
  2. Select a person or conversation.
  3. Type your message.
  4. Send it.

Send media & voice notes

Where supported, attach media or record a voice note. Your browser may ask for microphone permission when recording.

Organize your chats

Use available controls to pin, mute, archive or save conversations and messages. Drafts and scheduling options can help you manage messages.

Translate

When translation is available, use the translation action on a message and choose the language you want.

Audio & Video Calls

Talk privately with eligible connections.

Start an audio call

Open an eligible private conversation and choose the call option. The recipient can accept or decline.

Start a video call

Choose the video call option and allow camera access when your browser asks.

During a call

Use the available controls to mute your microphone, turn your camera on or off, and end the call.

Best experience: use a stable connection and an up-to-date browser. Headphones can reduce echo.

Rooms

Find communities and join the conversation.

Discover Rooms

Browse Rooms to find communities that match your interests. Open a Room to learn more before joining.

Join a Room

Use the Room's join option. Some Room experiences may require you to complete an account step before participating.

Chat in a Room

Choose a channel, read the conversation and send messages. Replies, reactions and other actions appear when supported.

Community activities

Depending on the Room, you may find polls, events, announcements, moments, rules and member information.

Create a Room

If Room creation is available to your account, follow the creation flow and complete any steps shown on screen.

⚽ SPIKE Predictor

Follow fixtures, review model picks, and keep predictions you want to revisit.

Today's fixtures

Open SPIKE Predictor to see available fixtures and the prediction markets currently supplied to the app.

Compare picks

Review the model's projected score, confidence information and available markets before deciding what to save.

Save a prediction

Use the ☆ Save control on a prediction to keep it in your Saved view for quick access later.

Remember what the model means

Predictions are model estimates, not guarantees. Missing fixtures or markets simply means the relevant data is not currently available.

Open Predictor: use the Predictor page from the app when available. Your saved picks stay separate from the social Feed.

Notifications

Keep up with important activity.

Review notifications

Open Notifications to see updates such as mentions, announcements and system activity.

Find what matters

Use the available categories and unread filter to quickly find notifications that need your attention.

Mark as read

Mark individual notifications as read or use the available bulk action.

Safety & Privacy

Stay in control of your SPIKE experience.

Report

Report inappropriate posts, profiles, messages or Room activity using the relevant report control.

Block

Use blocking controls when you no longer want to interact with an account.

Share carefully

Only share information you are comfortable making available to your selected audience. Never post passwords or authentication codes.

Protect your account

Never give your password or authentication codes to another person. Be cautious with unfamiliar links and requests for sensitive information.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers when something doesn't go as expected.

I forgot my password. What do I do?

Use the password recovery option on the sign-in screen and follow the instructions.

Why did I get signed out?

Your session may have expired or become invalid. Sign in again. If it keeps happening, check your internet connection and browser settings.

Why can't I upload media?

Check your connection, file type and size, then try again. If the issue continues, try an up-to-date browser.

Why aren't my messages updating?

Check your connection and refresh the conversation. If necessary, sign out and back in.

Why can't I make a call?

Check that you have an eligible connection, a stable internet connection, and the required microphone/camera browser permissions.

Why can't I send a Room message?

The Room may temporarily restrict posting, or your membership/role may not allow it. Check the Room information or ask a Room team member.

Why can't I see a feature?

Some features depend on your account, connection, Room membership, device or browser capabilities. Make sure your browser is up to date and complete any steps shown in the app.

What should I include when contacting support?

Tell us what you were trying to do, where it happened, and what you saw. Never send passwords, authentication codes, private keys or other secrets.
